quickref.status: Added BBG 2.17 (Mar 8, 2015); in fan footage to Jul 2016; 2026 status unknown
quickref.look: Two pale olive-lime tubes (#93994A-#9A9F4F) with silver octagonal muzzles, one on each shoulder; first person, olive tubes jut from the lower screen corners. HUD icon: one olive segmented tube with a pistol grip. Not red-orange.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 1 s rate of fire, 750 u/s, -10% speed (wiki). A yellow-orange flash at the tube mouth sends two stubby silver-grey rockets out side by side, each with a gold collar band and yellow star-shaped tail fins (#EFC63F), trailing grey low-poly smoke puffs. At range they read as a thin white streak. Fan HUD clip counts vary 3-5 with Ammo+ equipment.
quickref.impact_end_result: Huge white jagged starburst (#FEFDFF) with long yellow rays (#FCFE60) in a cyan haze; on a target, an orange-pink fireball with peach smoke; grey faceted smoke puffs linger. AoE 125/250 (wiki). No kill frame. All evidence is 2015-16 fan thumbnails, and attribution is moderate.

quickref.status: BBR launch loadout 2011 to BBG; seen in 2015-16 fan footage; BBH successor is Firework Flurry; 2026 status unknown
quickref.look: Four slim red rockets (#D02C34) with orange-red cones; each has a grinning pink-violet Huggable face (big dark eyes, wide white toothy grin). They stand upright on a black-and-grey back bar with gold fuses. HUD icon: four red rockets with grey tips.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Rockets leap straight up past the camera in pairs on long yellow-white flame plumes. 0.5 s rate of fire. The official clip was cut from 30 to 10 in Dec 2013, but 2015-16 HUDs read 30-35. They tip over and fall in a 'spiralling cascade' onto the reticle spot; a descending one reads as an orange nose with a white-yellow streak. The official text says they lock on; the wiki says they cannot now.
quickref.impact_end_result: A scattered cluster of chunky low-poly orange fire puffs (#E7912A) with yellow and white-hot cores and red, pink and white spark flecks ('a flurry of damaging, orange sparks'). No single big blast. AoE 125/250. No kill frame. Possibly also the row of burning floor flames in the Steam trailer at about 30-32 s (weak).

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.13 (Oct 31, 2014); changed in 2.17 (Mar 2015) to pause before diving; seen in the Oct 2026 final playtest build 3.0.7
quickref.look: Long red rocket-lance (#D72631-#EC1A30): pointed nose with canard fins, black-and-white checkered band behind the nose, yellow collar (#F8E312), big swept red tail fins. Worn diagonally on the back over the right shoulder; held diagonally in first person. About 0.9x Tillman's height.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: No lock. Slow lift (50 u/s), a brief hang, then a fast dive (1,100 u/s) nose-first onto the aim point (floor or ceiling), trailing a thick white smoke column (#FDFAF9) with blue-grey puffs. 1 round, 5 s reload.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosive with the largest AoE of these five (150/400, wiki). No image of the blast was found, so its look is undocumented (BBG News invention needed).

quickref.status: In BBR by Mar 2012 to BBG; in SkyVu's Jun 2014 overhaul loadout; magazine 8 (BBR) cut to 6 (Dec 2013); 2026 status unknown
quickref.look: The Big Shot drum in polished gold with an orange glowing muzzle disc, held two-handed at the belly; first person, a pale gold drum. HUD icon: a gold drum with a yellow turbine face.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A 'gold bullet-like missile' on a straight path with no arc (wiki); 1.5 s rate of fire, 1,200 u/s. Fan frames show a thin straight white-to-pale-yellow tracer.
quickref.impact_end_result: A compact lemon-yellow starburst (#F1EB58) with a near-white core and short white star spikes; at point blank, a white star-spiked flash over a flat orange floor ring. Officially a smaller explosion than the Big Shot's. No kill frame.

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.5 (Nov 27, 2013); wiki page still current; 2026 status unknown
quickref.look: Thick green tube with a darker octagonal mouth, yellow-orange shooting-star decals and black fins, worn on the back aimed forward; first person, the green tube with orange-yellow star swirls is held low-left. HUD icon: a green cone with yellow-orange stars; 1 round.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Green crescent lock brackets close on the target (lock in 2-2.5 s within 300 units). The tube shoots up for several seconds, drops, and stops just above the floor (or short under a ceiling).
quickref.impact_end_result: Not an explosive. It sprays 'a deadly shower of sparks and fire' downward for about 3.25 s (55 dps) and can hit its user. No gib. No image of the spray was found, so the spray look is undocumented.

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.5 (Nov 27, 2013) [Fan-wiki]; live in fan footage through 2.26 (~2017); BBH basic attack 'Blast-o-Mole' [Canon]
quickref.look: Chunky purple robot mole (#675992–#7865B3, shadow #2F2654) with a long silver-white cone drill nose (pink-magenta glow at base, #D174D3), white claws, dark spiky whiskers; held two-handed at belly; ~0.4x Tillman, ~0.35x Oliver [Observed: WAvg_EsRfBA sd1, -PRKUALJwR4 sd1, OFcrVn3MuVQ maxres1; size Inference]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobbed in a slight arc [Fan-wiki]; the mole itself flies nose-first or tumbles, no visible trail [Observed]; HUD clip reads 1, 2 or 3 across uploads [Observed]
quickref.impact_end_result: Tall soft billowing flame pillars (core #FFFFFF, lemon #FEFC68, orange #FB9B42, edge #C85620) rise from the floor and stand in a receding row, ~6 in a straight line per wiki [Observed: 4gVS6wpj0JY maxres3, PcNh1B1AyA8 maxresdefault, Gb1o4kcPxgk maxres1, tOi19pdqQXk maxres1; count Fan-wiki]; victims burst into toy pieces with blue bolt tokens; self-kill possible (SUICIDE feed, OFcrVn3MuVQ) [Observed; attribution Inference, strong]

quickref.status: Added BBG 2.2 (Aug 21, 2013); wiki 'removed later' (2020) and class page 'Unavailable' [Fan-wiki]; fan videos titled 'is back' ~2021 [Unverified]; 2026 unknown
quickref.look: White/silver bell-mouthed launcher, orange band with bomb-face decal and white 'PUSH' lettering, yellow tab [Observed: ZB6ajSQ2qF8 sd2, YpIzNzI0wrY maxres3, iqINXuuoO9k maxres2]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobs a round near-black (#181317) cartoon bomb: one white slit eye under angry brow, red lips, curled lit fuse; bounces, exploding at each contact, final blast on 3rd bounce, cannot hit players directly [Observed bomb 2014 and 2021; Fan-wiki mechanics]
quickref.impact_end_result: Close-up: translucent low-poly faceted orange dome (shell #CF4D1C, mid #F18D36, yellow #FEFD68, white core) beside the bomb [Observed: iqINXuuoO9k maxres2, ZB6ajSQ2qF8 sd2]; at contact/distance: yellow star/ray burst (#F4FC5E) [Observed: mgxkTERq5XM hq2, fWDn0EY0xBI sd1]; grey-white smoke puffs; kill = white flash, victim breaks into toy pieces [Observed: 2aYkjM3xQSI maxres1]; magenta domes in Betty videos are Pain Fields, not Betty [Inference]

quickref.status: BBR (by Mar 2012) to BBG; live in BBG 2.22 footage (~2015) [Fan video title]; 2026 unknown
quickref.look: Purple clawed blaster with glowing violet tip and yellow light slot (unchanged from verified dossier) [Observed again: FGEi-rBIKyQ maxres1]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Launch: white flash with pale-pink bloom (#FEC4FF) and cyan arcs (#9BE7E0) at the claw tip, white streak out [Observed: aBTIM7VlKwk maxres3, FGEi-rBIKyQ maxres3]; slow hot-pink orb with white core and cyan arcs [Observed in verified dossier]
quickref.impact_end_result: BBR 2012: opaque pure-black spheres (#000000) wrapped in jagged cyan-blue lightning (#8ADCF5/#367BB5), big enough to fill a doorway (~1.5-2x a bear) [Observed: oQ9YCxd7kq4 sd1, sd2; Dark Matter attribution Inference, strong]; blocks the victim's vision 1-2 s [Fan-wiki]; BBG blast not yet seen, only a 2.22 kill aftermath with armour pieces and blue bolt tokens [Observed: OPqn8iD3nwY maxres2]
